messages:
Priya (capacity): Heads up — I'm proposing a new autoscaling policing config for EU‑W to handle Q4 promo traffic. Goal: keep burst headroom for spiky requests but cap cost by mixing preemptible GPUs and a soft runway buffer. thoughts?
Sam (infra): Need clarity on how this affects cold start + cross‑AZ pod placement. preemptible evictions have previously caused p95 spikes.
Chen (sre): can we run the synthetic-replay against the tuning before rollout? if we can reproduce eviction cascades we can test circuit breakers.
Priya (capacity): Yep — prepared sim traces (link: https://internal/sim/q4-euw). Key numbers: expected peak +35% for 72 hours; baseline monthly GPU hours ~120k. Proposal summary: soft_runway=4h (maintain capacity to cover 4h of steady traffic), burst_ceiling=1.6x steady, preemptible_share target=40% (with automatic throttling), reserve_high_priority=20% for critical routes.
Leo (finance): :eyes: estimated cost impact?
Priya (capacity): Quick calc: if preemptible mix hits 40% we project ~18% GPU hour savings (~$65k/mo). Tradeoff: small tail risk — +2–3% p95 on non‑critical routes during the 72h window in worst case.
Sam (infra): I want an explicit fallback path: if eviction_rate > 8% over 10m, throttle preemptible usage and spill to dedicated pool. Also enforce node CPU headroom >15% for burst candidates; we saw network queuing when CPU saturated.
Chen (sre): Add the following circuit rule in the autoscaler:
```
if eviction_rate_10m > 0.08 then
  reduce_preemptible_percent_by 0.2
  enable_dedicated_fallback for routes: [auth, billing, inference-priority]
  alert sev2
end
```
That should keep critical latency bounded.
Sam (infra): Also add a per-region ramp limiter. Cross-region cold failover currently takes ~42s in eu-west -> eu-central; that caused client retries in the last promo. We should avoid simultaneous fallbacks.
Priya (capacity): Good call. I'll include region_ramp_seconds=120 and staggered failover windows in the routing policy.
Chen (sre): Canary plan: run in staging with synthetic spike replay Monday, then 1% rollout to EU-W traffic Tue morning, 10% Tue evening, 100% Wed if metrics look ok. Canary metrics: p50/p95 latency, start_time_distribution, kube_pod_evictions, preemptible_eviction_rate.
Priya (capacity): I'll open the PR with config: `soft_runway_hours=4`, `burst_ceiling=1.6`, `preemptible_target=0.4`, `reserve_priority=0.2`, `eviction_guard=0.08`, plus runbook text.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary pipeline triggered for autoscaler-config-2026-1810001400 — monitor /eng-sre and /eng-infra.
Sam (infra): One more ask — include a small experiment to try 60% preemptible on a non‑critical fleet for 24h to validate eviction patterns under real traffic. Preferably use smaller model shapes first.
Priya (capacity): Will do. I'll note that as an A/B test in the PR. Thanks all, will post the PR and a short GPU‑hours vs surge table in this thread.
